blocks.html: Where concrete piers are entirely encased within a circular steel shell, and the area of the shell steel is considered reinforcing steel, the steel shall be protected under the conditions specified in Section 1810.2.12. Horizontal joints in the shell shall be spliced to comply with Section 1810.2.11.
